        "content": "For Continual-ARC task task-6f4d555a, treat the small non-background marker shape as a template. Find every translation where all corresponding cells in the grid are 0, then recolor the union of matched cells with the marker color. Additional confirmed fresh-instance evidence: a color-1 marker formed offsets {(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)} in its 3x3 bounding box. Scanning all in-bounds translations where those six input cells were 0, then recoloring their union to 1, solved a 16x25 test correctly without demos; match anchors (zero-based) were (6,8), (10,16), and (13,15). The marker geometry can vary by instance, so derive offsets from the actual marker each time; only occupied template cells need match zeros, and do not constrain cells in the bounding-box holes or surrounding area.\n\nAdditional confirmed fresh-instance evidence: the marker was color 8 with tight 2x2 offsets {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0)} (an L triomino missing the lower-right cell). On the 29x11 test, scan all in-bounds anchors whose three corresponding cells are 0 and recolor the union to 8, preserving other cells; this submission was correct with zero wrong attempts. Match anchors (zero-based) were [(1, 4), (3, 0), (5, 1), (6, 1), (6, 5), (7, 0), (7, 1), (8, 0), (10, 7), (13, 6), (13, 7), (14, 3), (14, 4), (14, 5), (14, 6), (15, 3), (16, 6), (16, 7), (17, 6), (17, 7), (18, 4), (20, 2), (22, 2), (22, 8), (26, 5)].         "content": "For Continual-ARC task-b2cb1132, identify the uniform background, two equal-length color-6 bars on opposing borders, and sparse color-9 markers. Pair bar cells by their offset along the bars. A marker on a perpendicular ray from one bar activates that offset pair: draw color 9 from the marker-side bar cell to the marker, recolor the marker to 4, and draw color 9 from the paired cell on the opposite bar all the way to the far edge, including the far-edge interior cell. Preserve both bars and every unrelated/background cell. In a validated 20x19 instance, the top bar occupied columns 9–17 and the bottom bar columns 0–8, so top column 9+k paired with bottom column k. Markers at (row,column) (4,14), (7,17), (9,16), (14,13), and (17,12) activated offsets k=5,8,7,4,3. Their top-side rays filled columns 14,17,16,13,12 from row 1 through each marker; paired bottom-side rays filled columns 5,8,7,4,3 from row 0 through row 18; each marker became 4. Do not project every bar cell without a marker, and do not fill both directions in the marker’s own column.         "content": "For Continual-ARC task-8dd34bc8, input is an N×N grid and output is 2N×2N, formed by four N×N blocks: top-left is the input unchanged; top-right is the input rotated 90° clockwise; bottom-left is the input rotated 90° counterclockwise; bottom-right is the input rotated 180°. Validate output dimensions, preserve the original in TL, and check each rotated block independently. Common pitfall: manual rotations can omit an edge marker; use source-to-output coordinate formulas or standard matrix rotations. Validated from three demos (15→30, 6→12, 9→18) and a fresh 4×4 test. The first test submission was wrong from hand-calculation errors in the last rows of the clockwise and 180° blocks, then corrected successfully. Low-cost strategy: request demos until the four-quadrant rotation pattern is clear, then submit.",

        "content": "Validated rule for Continual-ARC task-4342a43e: Find the large L-shaped marker (the largest L object) and use its color as the recoloring color. Locate repeated congruent object-pattern copies, then recolor the copy lying on the side opposite the L’s horizontal arm relative to its vertical stem. Since the arm extended right, select the copy on the left of the stem (the color-8 copy) and recolor its six cells to 4; leave the color-7 copy unchanged. The separate small color-8 L at rows 8–11, cols 3–4 is a distractor and must not be recolored. Two demonstrations also show that targets may differ in size/form and that identical-color distractors can occur: use congruent copies and the side rule, not proximity or generic L appearance.
